clips.title: The story
paras: Moon Horror Den is a secluded, frost-rimed cave located just northeast of the goblin trading post of Everlook in Winterspring. Tucked against the jagged mountainside, the cavern serves as a nesting hollow for ferocious raging owlbeasts. Travelers must take care when venturing near its icy mouth, as these territorial wildkin fiercely defend their shelter.

Situated only a short trek northeast from Everlook's guarded gates, the Moon Horror Den cuts deep into the mountain rock. The cave is home to powerful raging owlbeasts—formidable wildkin known for their brute strength and feral disposition in the harsh snows of Winterspring. Although geographically close to the furbolg settlement of Winterfall Village to the south, the sheer mountain face creates an impassable natural barrier, ensuring the den remains an isolated refuge for the wildkin rather than a corridor of travel.
